newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania launches two rollover T-bill issues.
newsitem.headline: Romania launches two rollover T-bill issues.

text.p: Romania's Finance Ministry said on Friday it would launch two rollover treasury bill issues totalling 949.54 billion lei to cover maturing papers.

The 91-day bills are offered with a coupon giving an annual yield equal to the three-month Bucharest Interbank Offered Rate (BUBOR) set five working days ahead of the public subscription sessions, scheduled for April 17 and April 21.
The bills, to be placed by the central bank, may be bought by banks operating in Romania and their corporate clients.
Three-month BUBOR was 176.52 percent on Thursday.
Money market traders said banks might rush to buy the fixed-interest papers as their returns are likely to stay well above money market prices, which hovered near 100 percent.
